notes.note: The focus surface establishes the ordinary frame: the named peoples are presented as an accusative pair; their dwellings make the destruction manifest to the addressed audience; the adversary beautifies their deeds, turns them from the definite path, and the closing participle preserves a qualified claim of prior insight. Global HFT records are visible, but their unanchored summaries and broad context deltas require their support and connection records before any wider trigger can be retained.

The complete branch inventory shows the focus form مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ is registered under multiple ب ص ر branches. The bodily-vision branch and the inward-knowledge branch are accepted distinct alternatives; the illumination branch is qualified, while blood, weapon, seam, and soft-stone branches are separate senses without an independent global trigger in this batch. Several global HFT-only branches are unresolved and explicitly lack a registered carrier, so their attributed images cannot by themselves activate a wider reading.

The focus roots ب ي ن and ز ي ن expose several distinct lexical branches. The focus form تَبَيَّنَ has an accepted global-linked branch for becoming visible and clear (root_000170/B004), while the focus form زَيَّنَ has an accepted global-linked branch for beautifying/making beauty visible (root_000660/B002). The other supplied global-linked branches in this batch are unresolved HFT attributions without registered focus carriers; they remain visible for qualification but cannot activate a branch alone.

The focus branch for سَبِيل (root_000672/B001) is accepted and carries both a physical route and an instrumental route toward an end, with a contextual religious specialization. It is linked to three global candidates, but activation still requires a concrete wider trigger. The many other س ب ل branches (traveler, endowment, lowering, rain, beard, vessel edge, grain head, game stick, eye disease) are distinct and uncandidate, so they do not accumulate into the global reading merely through root sharing.

The focus noun مَسَاكِنِهِمْ has a qualified global-linked branch for fixed places/positions and conventional place expressions (root_000726/B009), distinct from ordinary settlement, dwellings, inhabitants, inner calm, poverty, and other س ك ن branches. The focus adversary noun has a reframed distance/estrangement branch and an accepted branch for an unruly rebellious evil being; these are lexical context for the ordinary reading, not global activation without a separate returning trigger.

The focus verb صَدَّ has an accepted branch for turning away and restraining (root_000848/B001), linked to the global candidates on rival path, nonbinding knowledge, and effort/path. Its ordinary transitive frame already explains turning the peoples away from the path; a global finding would need an independent wider carrier and an altered focus reading. The remaining ص د د branches are unrelated sound, bodily-fluid, animal, place, applause, veil, or cosmetic senses, while the HFT-only cognition branch is unresolved and cannot serve as a carrier by itself.

The focus noun أَعْمَالَهُمْ has an accepted global-linked branch for deliberate work/action (root_001046/B001), linked to assay/judgment, fabricated falsehood, and embodied practice candidates. Its ordinary semantics are conscious deeds, including good or bad behavior; any global reading must add a distinct wider trigger and return through this object, rather than replacing the ordinary deed reading. Other work-related branches (using, appointing, wages, workers, effort, tools, roads) are distinct and uncandidate.

The remaining focus root ع و د branches are ordinary lexical alternatives around return, habit, time, benefit, celebration, old roads, wood, and the proper name ʿĀd; none is linked as an activated global candidate in this packet. A nominated global image for road robbery/blocking the way is a source image without a registered carrier, so it cannot independently activate the focus path noun. HFT-only test and speech branches likewise remain unresolved until support/connection records are inspected.

The remaining 29:38 carriers in this batch are non-activating alternatives: kāna B003/B004/B005/B006 cover person-specific guarantee, submission, age reminiscence, and a bad-state night collocation, while HFT-only records for occupation/displacement/escape, public council, publicized wrongdoing, eye inspection, restraint, guidance, and mutual love are unresolved with no registered focus carrier. These records cannot independently activate a global reading; kāna B001 is the only accepted focus branch and was already linked to the state-dependent salience candidate.

The candidate inventory separates six anchored global proposals from nine legacy-unbound HFT summaries. Anchored records provide specific focus words, citable supports, and context: dwelling witness (cand_ffee06c640990df3c516), beautification-to-obstruction (cand_054980ab1a7f88d7bd02), named adversary recurrence (cand_1c213b841c05b56c10c3), path obstruction (cand_6e59a114678378ea1967), inverse insight echo (cand_aa2e52e4810029adf4f6), and Thamud ruin field (cand_500e1a8d4f85d358b695). The nine unanchored summaries explicitly remain single inventory items with legacy_unbound status; they cannot supply a standalone surah thesis or lexical activation without registered focus carriers and candidate-specific support review.

This batch supplies six anchored context deltas with complete Arabic anchors and explicit changed readings. They connect the focus to assay and cognition (cand_2eba703117e453f48de4), recruitment onto a rival path with false burden transfer (cand_3da929e6a62922e844d9), socially normalized fabrication and road obstruction (cand_c8da6ae730c2e7bb770d), dwellings as reproducible field evidence (cand_0d0a8651cf8736a990ff), embodied practice as inhibition of attractive wrongdoing (cand_18fd8cc8b4fefc8c9168), and literal but nonbinding knowledge (cand_eff6f2741bc0415655e9). Each record remains legacy_unbound HFT nomination evidence, so branch activation still depends on the registered branch and connection inventories; the citable supports provide distinct triggers, changed readings, and reader payoffs for later decision review.

The final candidate batch gives three anchored global deltas: state-dependent salience (cand_2e491022b5747ed267d7), security-belief collision (cand_21f509a01c539ee2988d), and effort opening plural paths (cand_f2ec08c088717523861f). Their supports explicitly contrast ordinary distraction and crisis purification, perceptual recognition with misallocated trust, and blocked singular path with effort answered by guidance and plural roads. All are legacy_unbound HFT nominations with complete context Arabic; branch and connection catalogs must determine whether the proposed trigger carriers are registered and whether the global reading is distinct from the local surface paraphrase.

The complete 30-record connection batch contains many direct, reciprocal global parallels and explicit no-value boundaries. Strong recurring links include the same Satanic beautification-to-obstruction formula (27:24, 16:63, 8:48, 47:25), field-surviving dwellings (46:25 and 51:37), and path obstruction after discernment (43:37, 13:33, 47:32, 27:4). Medium or weak records add social and field context, while no-value records explicitly exclude unrelated divine/cosmic adornment, generic divine sight, infernal ṣadīd, and generic ease. Connection prior labels remain nominations only; they must be weighed with candidate-specific supports and registered carriers.

The second connection batch reinforces two high-value global routes: surviving dwellings as public historical evidence (28:58, 20:128, 32:26), and beautified or socially protected action producing path obstruction (63:2, 9:37, 47:1, 4:115). It also supplies a close post-clarity parallel where people choose another path after guidance is clear (4:115), and a medium candidate-relevant link where adornment is a test of action (18:7). Numerous weak/no-value records explicitly limit generic seeing, generic being, unrelated afterlife/return, and unrelated group or unseen references; these should not inflate global findings.
